title: PostgreSQL GIN (Generalized Inverted) Indexes on JSONB
realWorldScenario: An audit log query `SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE properties @> '{"ip_country": "DE"}';` takes 4 seconds on 5 million records.
questionStatement: Why is a standard B-Tree index incapable of accelerating arbitrary JSONB key/value searches? How does a GIN index work on JSONB columns?
expectedConcepts: Tokens mapping to row ID posting lists
hints: Think of GIN like an index at the back of a textbook mapping terms to page numbers.
